rows.title: VS Code not selecting environment in .venv/ on open with Environments extension installed
What is the global environment for?
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the context. Your extension should keep setting the project-scoped environment rather than also changing the legacy global environment; consumers should subscribe to the Python Environments extension's flat `api.onDidChangeEnvironment` event and use the core Python extension's legacy event only as a fallback, as described in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python-environments/issues/1491#issuecomment-4383115486. Ruff and ty have since added that integration in https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-vscode/pull/1035 and https://github.com/astral-sh/ty-vscode/pull/406. Further usage questions can go to https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python/discussions/categories/q-a.

rows.title: Ignoring change watch events misses fast re-creation events and leaves environment state stale
[Python Environments] default value of python-envs.workspaceSearchPaths is not respected
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. The extension currently defaults to `.venv` and `*/.venv`, not `./**/.venv`; that depth limit was introduced intentionally in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python-environments/commit/3bb8ab8c51f9096f31d4322fdd9c35193eb42741 to avoid expensive recursive discovery. The linked documentation is therefore stale and should be corrected. For absolute locations shared across workspaces, `python-envs.globalSearchPaths` is available at user level; workspace-relative recursive patterns remain workspace-scoped.

rows.title: Path-only pythonProjects entries crash manager initialization
VS Code discovers Conda environments but Python: Select Interpreter does not display them
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the detailed report and confirmation of the no-Python Conda environment. This was fixed on the core Python extension's main branch in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python/commit/e0f1d3c80da21e0246b007990f6513fed9017080 via https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-python/pull/26112. The compatibility adapter now skips Conda environments that are not Python interpreters and isolates malformed entries so they cannot prevent later valid environments from reaching the Python and Jupyter pickers. The fix is currently main-only, so I believe this can be closed as completed.
rows.verifyEvidence: Fix only rescues batches containing a no-Python Conda placeholder; the report shows eight Conda envs discovered with Python executables and no placeholder evidence, and the commit itself claims only 'Related to' this report.

rows.title: Leverage execution.exitCode for execution promise resolve
Breaks python stack, delays venv activation, forgots settings, installs automatically even after being uninstalled.
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the detailed context. The delayed activation path is visible in the current source: command-mode activation may wait for shell integration and then send the activation command into the terminal, which can interfere with typing. As a workaround, set `python-envs.terminal.autoActivationType` to `shellStartup` or `off`; `python.useEnvironmentsExtension: false` disables this extension's experience after reloading. For the forgotten Poetry selections and `fromEnvironment` tool failures, please attach the output from **Help: Report Issue** together with trace-level logs from the **Python Environments** output channel so the integration boundary can be traced.
